Daily district counts are available for 2024-2025 but diagnosis definition, district scheme and small-cell suppression are undocumented, and access is pending. Holiday calendar (api.nager_public_holidays) is not usable until its licence is found.
No patient-level source is usable: clinic.patient_visits is excluded by clinic_data_policy, and no other candidate provides event-level clinic records.
Both Eurostat candidates have unresolved licences (LIC-UNKNOWN) and end in 2023, so they do not cover the production window; the prototype overlaps only 2005.

overall_rationale: All must needs (N1, N2, N3) are met only with conditions. N1 prototype depends on the UCI dataset, whose research-only note needs Legal confirmation and whose -200 sentinels must be recoded. N1 production and N2 depend on internal sources that need access grants, a VR-03 outage check and a Mobility Office break adjustment. N3 uses Open-Meteo, which needs a Valdena coordinate and licence-mix checks. N4 (should) is met with conditions via internal clinic counts. N5 (could) and N6 (could) are unmet; N6 is blocked by unresolved Eurostat licences and coverage ending 2023. No must need is unmet, so the overall verdict is feasible_with_conditions, driven by N1, N2 and N3.
